Name: Wild Tree Tweaks
Author: chiccenSDV
Description:
Wild Tree Tweaks is an original mod inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21449]Fruit Tree Tweaks[/url] by aedenthorn, which I have undertaken the burden of updating to 1.6. I learned a lot when updating that mod, and have applied much of that to this mod, as well. If you encounter issues, disable the mod and please post a bug report. If you'd like to contribute, the source code is available on [url=https://github.com/chiccendev/StardewValleyMods/tree/main]my Github.[/url]

DESCRIPTION
===========

This mod lets you tweak wild trees in the following ways:

[list]
[*]Change the likelihood of overnight tree growth
[*]Allow planting trees on most valid tiles
[*]Allow trees to grow in all seasons without fertilizer
[*]Change how many hits with an axe a tree requires before it falls
[*]Change likelihood of trees dropping a seed when shaken
[/list]
The default configuration is:
[code]EnableMod = true
OnlyOnFarm = false
GrowInWinter = true
GrowNearTrees = true
Health = 10
WoodMultiplier = 1
MysterBoxChance = 0.005
BookChanceBool = false
BookChance = 0.0005
SeedChance = 0.05
SeedSpreadChance = 0.15
[/code]
You can edit the config in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or by editing the mod's config.json file after starting the game once.

[size=5]Technical[/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/chiccendev/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/WildTreeTweaks]https://github.com/chiccenFL/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/WildTreeTweaks[/url]

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, message me on[url=https://discordapp.com/users/147114387096731649/] Discord[/url] (@chiccen). I am also reachable on the [url=https://discord.gg/stardewvalley]Official Stardew Valley Discord[/url] with the same username.
